name: home-assistant-os
description: Home Assistant Operating System 18.3, generic aarch64 (UEFI) board: the buildroot-external tree on the home-assistant fork of Buildroot 2024.02, internal glibc toolchain, systemd, Docker, a 6.18 mainline kernel
notes: Deviations from the board's own defconfig, applied to golden and Buck2 alike: no ccache (its cache directory is outside the build), no post-image script (it assembles disk images outside the rootfs), and a tar rootfs instead of EROFS so the manifest scanner can read it.
